name: Kinky twist
description:
The Kinky Twist is one of our most loved protective styles at Vibrate Warsaw, blending natural beauty with a touch of elegance. Created using high-quality kinky-textured extensions, this style offers a look that is both soft and voluminous, perfectly mimicking the natural curl pattern of Afro-textured hair.

Our stylists start with gentle parting and careful sectioning of the hair, ensuring minimal tension on the scalp while providing a uniform, neat finish. Each twist is installed delicately, intertwining the natural hair with kinky extensions to create lightweight, bouncy twists that move freely and feel incredibly natural.

This style is not only protective but also versatile, giving you the freedom to wear it loose, styled into buns, ponytails, or half-up looks. It’s the perfect choice for clients who want a natural-looking protective hairstyle that is both stylish and easy to maintain.

Style Options:

Shoulder-Length Kinky Twists – For a natural, everyday look.

Waist-Length Twists – A dramatic, fashion-forward option.

Jumbo Kinky Twists – Bold, chunky twists for a statement style.

Small/Medium Kinky Twists – A more intricate, fuller look.

Curled Ends – Add a soft and feminine finish with curled tips.

Half-Up, Half-Down – A versatile option for casual or elegant settings.

At Vibrate Warsaw, we pride ourselves on combining precision, care, and artistry. Each Kinky Twist is installed with comfort and hair health in mind, ensuring you leave our salon not only looking stunning but also feeling confident and cared for.

name: Haircut (Strzyżenie)
description:
Our barbers approach each haircut as a blend of art and precision. We begin with a consultation to understand your desired look and advise on what fits your face shape and lifestyle. Using sharp, sanitized tools and advanced techniques, we ensure clean fades, sharp line-ups, or tailored scissor cuts. Comfort, hygiene, and customer satisfaction are always top priorities.
Style Options: Skin fade, taper fade, scissor cut, buzz cut, children’s cut, father & son combo

name: Beard
description:
Beards are carefully shaped and edged with razors and clippers. Hydrating oils and hot towels enhance comfort and skin health.
Style Options: Full beard sculpt, stubble line-up, goatee maintenance.

name: Haircut & Dye
description:
For clients seeking a bold change, we offer coloring combined with fresh haircuts. Every step is performed with quality dyes to protect hair health.
Style Options: Blonde, platinum, bold colors, subtle tones.

name: Cornrows without Extension
description:
Classic cornrows performed with neat partings and scalp-friendly tension. Our braiders take time to ensure every row is smooth, uniform, and comfortable for long-lasting wear.
Style Options: Straight-back cornrows, zig-zag designs, feed-in patterns, men’s cornrows with fade.

name: consulation
description:
A free one-on-one discussion where our tattoo artist helps bring your vision to life. We prioritize hygiene, precision, and your comfort.

Style Options: Minimalist tattoos, lettering, sleeves, custom art.

name: Bob Box Braids
description:
Timeless protective style crafted with precision. Each braid is sectioned carefully to avoid scalp strain while delivering a clean, stylish finish.
Style Options: Small, medium, jumbo; long, bob-length; curly or straight ends.

name: Cornrows For Kids
description:
At Vibrate Warsaw, we know that children’s hairstyles require extra care, patience, and a gentle touch. Our Cornrows for Kids service is designed to give your child a neat, stylish, and comfortable look while ensuring their experience in the chair is relaxed and fun.

Our stylists are trained to handle delicate hair textures with care, using soft techniques and child-friendly products to protect the scalp and keep hair healthy. Every braid is done with precision, ensuring a long-lasting style that your child can wear confidently to school, special events, or everyday activities.

We also take time to make sure the braiding process is as comfortable as possible, with breaks if needed, so your child feels safe and cared for throughout the session.

Style Options:

Straight Back Cornrows – Classic, neat lines braided to the back.

Creative Patterns – Fun zig-zags, swirls, or curved parts for a playful touch.

Cornrows with Beads – Add colorful beads for extra flair and personality.

Half Cornrows, Half Afro – Cornrows at the front with loose natural hair at the back.

Side-Part Cornrows – A trendy yet child-friendly variation.

At Vibrate Warsaw, we believe every child deserves to feel special and stylish. Our priority is not only the hairstyle but also your child’s happiness and comfort  because when kids leave our salon smiling, that’s true customer satisfaction.

name: Natural Twists
description:
Our Natural Twists service at Vibrate Warsaw celebrates the beauty of textured hair while offering a protective, stylish, and versatile look. This hairstyle is created by delicately sectioning the hair and twisting two strands together, producing a clean, defined, and elegant style that works beautifully for both casual and special occasions.

We take pride in using gentle, professional techniques that minimize tension on the scalp, ensuring your comfort throughout the process. Our stylists apply nourishing, lightweight products to maintain hair health, reduce frizz, and enhance the natural curl pattern. Each twist is done with precision, creating a uniform finish that’s neat, long-lasting, and easy to maintain.

Whether you’re looking for a protective style to encourage hair growth, or simply a chic natural look, Natural Twists provide the perfect balance of simplicity and sophistication.

Style Options:

Two-Strand Twists – Classic, defined look for everyday wear.

Mini Twists – Smaller, detailed twists for a fuller style.

Flat Twists – Twists laid close to the scalp, with creative parting designs.

Twist Out – Twists unraveled for a soft, curly, voluminous look.

Accessorized Twists – Add beads, cuffs, or string for extra flair.

At Vibrate Warsaw, we approach every Natural Twists service with care and artistry, ensuring that your style not only looks beautiful but also promotes healthy hair. Your satisfaction is our top priority — because your crown deserves to shine.

name: Finger Curls
description:
Our Finger Curls service at Vibrate Warsaw is all about enhancing your natural beauty with soft, defined, and bouncy curls that radiate elegance. Using only your natural hair, our stylists carefully create uniform curls by hand, ensuring a gentle process that minimizes tension and maximizes definition.

This service is perfect for those who want a classic, timeless look that works for both formal events and everyday style. Each curl is crafted with precision, using high-quality products to lock in moisture, reduce frizz, and give your hair long-lasting shine and movement.

The process is not only about styling but also about care. our team treats your hair with nourishing products that protect its health while bringing out its natural beauty.

Style Options:

Classic Finger Curls – Uniform curls for a neat and elegant look.

Loose Finger Curls – Larger curls for a softer, more natural vibe.

Defined Spiral Curls – Tighter curls for extra bounce and texture.

Finger Curl Updo – Styled into an updo for weddings or formal occasions.

Accessorized Curls – Add clips, pins, or subtle accents for a personalized touch.

At Vibrate Warsaw, we focus on detail, comfort, and customer satisfaction. Finger Curls are not just a hairstyle—they are a statement of confidence, sophistication, and natural beauty.

name: Sleek Ponytail
description:
The Sleek Ponytail at Vibrate Warsaw is the ultimate blend of elegance, sophistication, and modern style. Designed for those who love a polished, flawless look, this hairstyle pulls the hair smoothly back into a ponytail with a silky finish that exudes confidence and class.

Our stylists begin by preparing and straightening the hair for a smooth base, using professional-grade heat protectants and nourishing serums to maintain hair health. Each section is carefully brushed and secured, ensuring a tension-free and comfortable hold. The ponytail is then styled according to your preference — high, mid, or low — with a sleek, glossy finish that lasts.

The service is performed with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring every strand is perfectly aligned. Whether for a professional event, night out, or special celebration, the Sleek Ponytail delivers a chic look that is both timeless and versatile.

Style Options:

High Sleek Ponytail – A bold, elevated style for maximum impact.

Mid Sleek Ponytail – Balanced and versatile for everyday wear.

Low Sleek Ponytail – Elegant and refined, perfect for formal occasions.

Wrapped Ponytail – Hair wrapped around the base for a seamless finish.

Accessorized Ponytail – Add beads, cuffs, ribbons, or glam pins for extra flair.

At Vibrate Warsaw, your satisfaction is our highest priority. We perform this style delicately, with comfort and hair health in mind, so that you walk out feeling confident, polished, and beautiful.

name: Jumbo Knotless Braids
description:
At Vibrate Warsaw, our Jumbo Knotless Braids are crafted to combine bold style with maximum comfort. Unlike traditional braids that use tight knots at the base, knotless braids start seamlessly with your natural hair, reducing tension on the scalp and allowing for more natural movement. The “jumbo” size offers a chic, statement-making look with larger braids that require less installation time while still giving you versatility and long-lasting wear.

Our stylists work with precision and delicacy, parting each section evenly and braiding smoothly to protect your hair while achieving a polished finish. We use premium extensions that blend beautifully with your natural hair, ensuring a lightweight feel that’s gentle on your edges and scalp.

This protective style is ideal for anyone who wants a trendy yet low-maintenance look that lasts weeks with proper care. It’s perfect for vacations, events, or simply giving your natural hair a stylish break.

Style Options:

Classic Jumbo Knotless – Clean, uniform braids for a bold everyday style.

Waist-Length Jumbo Knotless – Extra length for dramatic effect.

Curled Ends – Add a soft, playful touch with curled tips.

Half-Up, Half-Down – A chic, versatile variation.

Accessorized Braids – Elevate the look with beads, cuffs, or threads.

At Vibrate Warsaw, we prioritize not only the beauty of your hairstyle but also the health of your hair. Our team ensures your braids are installed comfortably, with attention to detail and care, leaving you with a look that’s protective, stylish, and confidence-boosting.

name: Braid Removal
description:
At Vibrate Warsaw, we understand that removing braids is just as important as installing them. Our Braid Removal Service is designed to protect your natural hair, ensuring the process is gentle, thorough, and stress-free.

Our stylists carefully take down each braid with precision, avoiding unnecessary pulling or breakage. We use professional tools and techniques to detangle your hair while preserving its strength and minimizing shedding. Once the braids are fully removed, we follow up with a hydrating detangling session to restore softness and prepare your hair for its next style.

We perform this service delicately, with your comfort and hair health as our top priority. Whether you’re transitioning to a new protective style, preparing for a treatment, or simply letting your natural hair breathe, our team ensures the removal process leaves your hair feeling refreshed and well-cared-for.

Service Includes:

Careful braid take-down by experienced stylists

Gentle detangling to reduce shedding

Optional wash & deep conditioning treatment (+100 zł)

Scalp massage to stimulate circulation and refresh the scalp

Ideal For:

Clients with box braids, knotless braids, twists, cornrows, or faux locs

Anyone who values protective, stress-free removal without damaging natural hair

At Vibrate Warsaw, your natural hair is always our priority. From the first braid to the last strand, we handle your hair with care, ensuring you leave the salon with a healthy foundation for your next look.

name: Faux Locs Removal
description:
At Vibrate Warsaw, we know that removing Faux Locs requires extra care and patience. Our Faux Locs Removal Service is designed to gently take down your locs while protecting your natural hair, ensuring the process is smooth, safe, and stress-free.

Our stylists use specialized techniques to carefully unravel or cut extensions without tugging or damaging your own strands. We pay close attention to detail, gently detangling as we go to reduce shedding and breakage. Once the locs are fully removed, we provide a deep detangling session to restore softness and prepare your natural hair for washing, treatments, or a new style.

We pride ourselves on handling every removal delicately, ensuring your hair remains healthy, strong, and manageable. Whether you had goddess locs, boho locs, or traditional faux locs, our team ensures the process is done with maximum comfort and care.

Service Includes:

Gentle, professional faux loc removal

Careful detangling to prevent knots and breakage

Scalp refresh with light oiling

Optional wash & deep conditioning treatment (+100 zł)

Guidance on transitioning to your next hairstyle

Ideal For:

Clients who want a stress-free, damage-free removal of faux locs

Anyone preparing their natural hair for its next protective or natural style

Those who value comfort, hair health, and professional care

At Vibrate Warsaw, we treat your natural hair with the same care we put into creating stunning styles. From installation to removal, we make sure your journey with us leaves you feeling confident, refreshed, and ready for what’s next.
